description: This file defines an abstract class 'DefinedName' which represents a named range or formula within a spreadsheet, including properties such as name, scope, value, and methods for creating, testing, and resolving named ranges or formulas.

classes.name: DefinedName
classes.description: An abstract class representing a named range or formula in a spreadsheet, including properties for name, scope, value, and methods to create and resolve named ranges or formulas.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a NamedRange or NamedFormula object based on whether the value is a formula.

methods.name: testIfFormula
methods.description: Static method that tests if a given string value represents a formula or range.

methods.name: resolveName
methods.description: Static method to resolve a named range to its corresponding object within the worksheet context.
